record.issue_text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:165 — updateCalendarAttendees` runs outside try/catch after attendees are saved, so a calendar error fails the request with guests already added and no emails sent, and a retry fails with emails_must_be_unique_valid

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, new attendees are persisted via `prisma.booking.update(... attendees.createMany ...)` before calling `await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking);`. That calendar update is not wrapped in a `try/catch`, so any thrown error will fail the mutation after the DB write, leaving guests added but without calendar sync or emails (emails are only attempted after and are separately wrapped). On retry, `uniqueGuests` filters out already-added attendee emails, can result in `uniqueGuests.length === 0`, and the handler throws `BAD_REQUEST` with `emails_must_be_unique_valid`, matching the finding.
